claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Lopinavir is a HIV protease inhibitor with no meaningful antiproliferative activity against human cancer cell lines at 2.5 uM; any killing would reflect nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a shared mechanism class.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Lopinavir is a HIV protease inhibitor with no meaningful antiproliferative activity against human cancer cell lines at 2.5 uM; any killing would reflect nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a shared mechanism class.
